The '''mighty banshee''' is a stronger version of the [[Banshee]] and is first encountered in the [[quest]] [[Smoking Kills]]. They are found in the [[Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon]]. [[Masked earmuffs]], a [[Slayer helmet]], a [[Full slayer helmet]], a [[Mask of Mourning]] or a [[Helm of Keening]] must be worn to prevent stats from being dangerously reduced in addition to successive damage by the swirling dust.

They attack with powerful fire spells that hit quite hard for their level, so [[Protect from Magic]] is recommended for lower level players.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Ranged ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Magic ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Melee ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament & Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended
**Mighty banshee's combat level has been decreased from level 91 to level 61

* {{UL|type=hidden|update=New Skill: Necromancy - This Week In RuneScape|date=7 August 2023}}
** Mighty banshee's weakness was changed from bolts to arrows.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Completionist Cape Strike & Retro Saradomin God Armour - This Week In Runescape|date=17 April 2023}}
** Fixed the issue of incorrect souls being captured by Ushabti.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=This Week In RuneScape: Once Upon A Time: Fortunes|date=5 July 2021}}
** [[Slayer Masters]] are now able to assign banshee tasks to players wearing the [[Mask of Mourning]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape - 26/10/20#Patch Notes|date=26 October 2020}}
** Monsters with multiple variants will now consistently spawn as those variants when newly placed in the Personal Slayer Dungeon.
*** This includes banshees.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (14 January 2013)|date=14 January 2013}}
** Mighty banshees now deal an appropriate amount of damage.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Smoking Kills|date=5 June 2008}}
** Added to game.
}}
